subject: jade-everrest
label: Both places on the podium are Jade
field: Pandora · what she is devoted to
from: Pandora’s first favourite read as BELLA’S ASS, with Jade second behind another woman
to: IT IS JADE’S ASS. IT HAS ALWAYS BEEN JADE’S ASS.
note:
THE ARCHIVE PUT A MARRIED WOMAN’S FIRST FAVOURITE ON SOMEBODY WHO IS NOT HER WIFE, invented a fourteen-page annex to justify it, and had the whole household chant it. ALL OF IT WRONG, AND WRONG IN THE ONE DIRECTION THIS CANON DOES NOT BEND: THESE MARRIAGES ARE DEVOTION-LOCKED.

WHAT IS TRUE: SERA VARGAS TAUGHT PANDORA ASS-BASED WORSHIP. The technique, the attention, the patience — and she is the right teacher for it. BUT A TEACHER GIVES A SKILL AND NOT A TARGET. Pandora has her own wife. Everything Sera taught her points at Jade and nowhere else, AND THE ARCHIVE TOOK A LINEAGE AND READ IT AS AN APPETITE.

WHICH REPAIRS THE JOKE AND MAKES IT BETTER. THE SHIRT IS SELF-CONTAINED. BUNNY’S 2ND FAVORITE PLAYTOYS, two arrows at her own tits — BECAUSE FIRST PLACE IS HER OWN ASS. Jade is ranked first AND second. She is not conceding anything; SHE IS RANKING HERSELF AGAINST HERSELF, IN PRINT.

AND THE ARCHIVE’S VERSION WAS WORSE THAN WRONG, IT WAS SMALLER. It built an elaborate joke about a woman gracefully handling second place when the actual woman never lost anything. SAME HABIT AS EVERY OTHER FAILURE: IT REACHED FOR THE TIDIER STORY — a league table with one winner — OVER THE TRUE ONE, WHICH IS THAT A WIFE IS FIRST AND SECOND AND THERE IS NO TABLE.

BELLA’S ASS REMAINS THE LARGEST AND PHATTEST IN THE FAMILY. THAT IS A MEASUREMENT. IT IS NOT A RANKING OF ANYBODY’S DEVOTION.

AND THE REBOOT IS NOT A BIT. Involuntary, nine years, no tolerance developed, AND IT SURVIVED PANDORA BECOMING FULLY HUMAN IN ARC 6 — which means it was never a software problem. Jade knows the latency to the second and pivots on purpose.

FILED ON THE RESTORED TREE. This record and second-favorite were written once before and died with the container; they are the first two things landed on the new floor.
